about: One entry per output the hub makes. Rules: core/_system/staged-work.md. After editing run: node core/_system/scripts/workorder.mjs --write, then npm test. A layer points at its method in the owner skill; the method is never copied here. A state lists the layers it needs; must_pass names the ones that must be pass or carried, where n/a is not accepted.

concept-passes.name: Fundamentals
concept-passes.build: A compact brief: audience and situation, awareness and surface, one desire or problem, the offer and its defensible benefit, proof available and claims forbidden, one message and action, constraints, the exact deliverables asked for; plus a source note for the destination page and brand material actually looked at.
concept-passes.check: Can this ad do one clear job for this audience inside the brief, with every unknown fact left unknown?
concept-passes.evidence: The offer file's proof table and limits; the destination page opened and viewed, or the gap named; the ledger row's sentence when there is one.
concept-passes.on_fail: Resolve the brief or ask only for the blocking choice. Never invent a customer story or a fact to move on.

concept-passes.name: Premises
concept-passes.build: Several materially different premises, one sentence each, with why this audience would care and why the product belongs in the resolution.
concept-passes.check: Do the candidates differ in the underlying idea rather than the wording, and does each have a payoff the product is part of?
concept-passes.evidence: The premises side by side, with the ones rejected and why.
concept-passes.on_fail: Write new premises here. A category slogan or a novelty with no product payoff is rejected, not polished.

concept-passes.name: Cast and treatment
concept-passes.build: For the strongest premises: who or what acts, and separately how it is rendered, with the materially different alternative that was rejected.
concept-passes.check: Were cast and rendering chosen as two separate decisions, each for a stated reason tied to the brief and the brand evidence, not by default?
concept-passes.evidence: The chosen cast and rendering, the alternative considered, and the reason for each.
concept-passes.on_fail: A default choice returns to treatment exploration here. A cast that changes the idea's logic returns to premises.

concept-passes.name: Visual stop and hierarchy
concept-passes.build: The actual first frame or single image, described concretely: focal point, action or contrast, what is understood at once, the question it raises; then its hierarchy: first read, supporting cue, product or action read.
concept-passes.check: With the headline and sound taken away, would a distracted stranger have a specific reason to pause (or does the recorded opening dynamic's own test pass), and can the eye find the first read?
concept-passes.evidence: The frame description read alone with the copy hidden; the named reason to pause; the competing details removed, subordinated or kept on purpose.
concept-passes.on_fail: A weak idea returns to premises or cast and treatment, never to headline polishing. Competing details are recomposed here.

concept-passes.name: Connected payoff
concept-passes.build: The hook as image, text and sound; then opening, development, turn, product payoff and action for video, or one complete proposition for a static; key copy and call to action.
concept-passes.check: Does the payoff answer the opening's promise with the product, so a viewer remembers the benefit and not only the opening?
concept-passes.evidence: The sequence or composition read start to end as a stranger would meet it.
concept-passes.on_fail: A payoff that does not fulfil the opening returns to premises or the visual stop. Never attach a product screen to an unrelated opening.

concept-passes.name: Claims and permissions
concept-passes.build: The claims map: every factual thing the ad says, shows or implies (a number, rating, review, credential, guarantee, price, result, story, comparison, urgency, scarcity; implied claims count) set against the offer's proof, with the recorded permission behind any testimonial or customer story; then the policy check.
concept-passes.check: Does every claim the ad makes or implies map to a proof row or stand as a marked blank, with recorded permission behind every testimonial or customer story, and no personal attribute asserted?
concept-passes.evidence: The claims map read against the offer file's proof table, row by row; for each testimonial or story, the recorded permission; required strings read from the business's file.
concept-passes.on_fail: An unsupported claim is cut or becomes a marked blank. A testimonial or story with no recorded permission is not used, and the reply says so in one line. A personal attribute is rewritten around the situation. An idea that only works with the unsupported claim returns to the connection layer.

concept-passes.name: Adversarial review and revision
concept-passes.build: A separate review of each concept as a distracted viewer: attention, relevance and one job, promise and clarity, proof and policy, composition, distinctness and execution, brand continuity; rubric scores; revisions.
concept-passes.check: Does every gate pass with a concrete reason, with Hook and Glance at 4 or more and One job and Proof at 3 or more, and no average hiding a failed gate?
concept-passes.evidence: The seven verdicts with their reasons, the rubric scores, who reviewed (a fresh reviewer or self-review), and what changed in each revision cycle.
concept-passes.on_fail: Return to the pass that failed, change that part, review the connected whole again. Three cycles at most, then withhold the concept and report the shortfall.

copy.name: Copy per placement
copy.build: The fields each placement needs, within the platform layer's lengths: hook as text, first frame and sound; primary text; headlines; description; call to action; required strings; the final claims map.
copy.check: Is every word a person will read true to the claims map, free of personal attributes, in the business's voice and the copy standard, and does the hook still carry the concept that passed?
copy.evidence: Each field read against the claims map; a testimonial appears only where the claims layer recorded its permission; required strings read from the business's file; the rubric scores.
copy.on_fail: Rewrite the failing field here. A claim with no proof row is cut or marked blank. Copy that only works by changing the idea returns to the connection layer.

static-production.name: Authorised production
static-production.build: Only the image and the shapes the request authorises, in the platform layer's dimensions, with text and logos inside the safe zones; or, when nothing here can make it, the production brief.
static-production.check: Is each asset the concept that passed, in an authorised shape, with generated text and figures correct letter by letter?
static-production.evidence: Each file opened; its dimensions; its on-image text read against the gated copy.
static-production.on_fail: Regenerate or recompose that asset. An idea that cannot survive production returns to the visual stop. With no tool, write the production brief and mark this layer not checked.

static-production.name: Render review
static-production.build: An inspection of each actual file at the size it will be seen: a phone-width feed card or a full-screen vertical.
static-production.check: At delivery size, does the image stop on its own, read as one proposition at a glance, keep its hierarchy, and show exactly the gated claims with nothing cut off?
static-production.evidence: The actual pixels viewed at feed size with the copy hidden, then restored; the safe zones; the composition review repeated on the render; the rubric scores including Finish.
static-production.on_fail: Repair the render and inspect again, three cycles at most. A file that cannot be opened here is not checked and the row stays copy-ready.

video-build.name: First frame
video-build.build: The actual first frame, described and composed.
video-build.check: Does this frame pass the Pass 4 test recorded at the visual-stop layer: the visual-alone stop test for a cold visual feed, or the selected opening dynamic's test?
video-build.evidence: The frame viewed, with the headline and sound taken away.
video-build.on_fail: Recompose the frame, or return to the visual stop.

video-build.name: Scenes
video-build.build: Supplied footage, generated scenes, or both, for the sequence.
video-build.check: Do cast and treatment stay consistent, is the product demonstration true, and does generated imagery never misrepresent the product, the place or a person?
video-build.evidence: Each scene viewed, and the scenes compared with each other.
video-build.on_fail: Remake the scene, or return to the concept if the idea cannot survive production.

video-build.name: Captions and sound together
video-build.build: Burned-in captions and on-screen text, and the sound.
video-build.check: Does the ad read with the sound off, with text and logos inside the safe zones, generated text correct letter by letter and every claim identical to the gated draft?
video-build.evidence: The captions and on-screen text read against the gated copy; a play with the sound off.
video-build.on_fail: Fix the caption, text or sound that is wrong.

video-build.name: The edit
video-build.build: The scenes assembled against the sequence.
video-build.check: Does the hook land in the first frame and first three seconds, with no competing movement or overlays in the frames and transitions, and the turn and payoff preserved?
video-build.evidence: The assembled cut played against the sequence.
video-build.on_fail: Recut, or go back to the scene that causes it.

video-build.name: Placement versions
video-build.build: Only the authorised shapes; when a batch needs both feed and vertical, the vertical is a dedicated edit, not a crop.
video-build.check: In each authorised shape, is nothing cut off and the text inside that shape's safe zones?
video-build.evidence: Each version opened at its own size.
video-build.on_fail: Recompose that version. A missing planned shape is named, not made beyond scope.

video-build.name: Watch the export
video-build.build: Each final file watched at the size it will be seen, and the gates re-run on the execution.
video-build.check: Does each watched file hold its pacing, show only the gated claims and do the one job in the row?
video-build.on_fail: An unplayed file is unverified: say so and leave the row at copy-ready.

destination.name: Ad against destination
destination.build: The ad read beside the page it sends people to.
destination.check: Does the page deliver what the ad promises: the same offer, price, qualifications and next action?
destination.evidence: The destination page beside the ad, or the gap named.
destination.on_fail: A mismatch is fixed at the connection layer or reported to the business as a page gap. A page that cannot be seen from here is not checked: name it as an open item.

video-sequence.name: Script and sequence
video-sequence.build: The sequence from Pass 5: opening, development, turn, product payoff, action; when the product enters and which question it answers; the hook as what is read, heard and in the first frame.
video-sequence.check: Does the turn earn the reveal, with the product payoff connected to the opening rather than attached to an unrelated scene?
video-sequence.evidence: The sequence read start to end.

work_orders.name: Ads for a business or an offer, end to end
say: help me get more customers with ads
help me get bookings with ads
set up ads for this business
where do we start with ads
I want more bookings, leads or sales
take us from nothing to live ads
I need ads for my new offer
I want to start running ads
work_orders.not_for: A request that names one job (write three ads, check our tracking, how are the ads doing) goes straight to that job's work order.
work_orders.live: only through launch and management, under recorded authority

required: a sentence about the business and a goal

layers.name: Readiness
layers.build: The offer, its result loop, the supplied facts with a status on each, and the gaps split by what they block.
layers.check: Is there one offer with a real result source, and is every live gap named with who clears it?
layers.evidence: The offer file and the gap lists.
layers.on_fail: Stay here until the offer and its result loop are settled. Nothing downstream is planned on a guessed offer.

layers.name: Research the plan needs
layers.optional: as the decision needs it; skipping it is n/a with the reason
layers.build: Buyer language from sources actually read, and what others run, when the plan would otherwise rest on the business's own description.
layers.check: Does the plan have buyer language and alternatives from sources that were read, or is the gap stated as an assumption?
layers.evidence: The research files with their data labels, or the plan's assumption line.
layers.on_fail: Run the research work order, or carry the gap forward as a labelled assumption. Never fill it from general knowledge.

layers.name: Plan the batch
layers.build: The diagnosis, the batch with IDs, tags and reasons, and the test design from this offer's numbers.
layers.check: Does every planned ad have an ID and a reason no other row shares, with the bar and spend taken from the offer and authority files?
layers.evidence: The ledger rows and the test plan.
layers.on_fail: Back to the test-plan work order at the layer that failed.

layers.name: Make the batch
layers.build: Each planned ad through its own work order, then the batch checks.
layers.check: Is every row at the state its file and assets support, with the batch checked for sameness and each ad checked against its destination?
layers.evidence: Each creative file's layer record and the batch's record.
layers.on_fail: Back to the ad's own work order at the layer that failed.

layers.name: Make the result measurable
layers.build: The signal, the verified path and a test of the real result seen arriving.
layers.check: Has the real result been seen arriving on the platform on a stated date, or is it recorded as not yet seen with who clears it?
layers.evidence: The platform file's result-signal section.
layers.on_fail: Nothing goes live. The gap goes to the tracking-setup work order or to the person who can run the test.

layers.name: Launch
layers.build: Gates checked, objects created paused, previews shown, approval recorded, then activation.
layers.check: Was every gate named, and is anything live covered by an approval line written before it was activated?
layers.evidence: The gates table, the approvals log and the change entries.
layers.on_fail: Stop at the dry run and say what clears the open gate and who.

layers.name: Watch and manage
layers.build: A daily watch that acts only on emergencies, and scheduled sessions under the rulebook.
layers.check: Did every change come from an emergency condition or a scheduled session, with an entry and an undo?
layers.evidence: The change log.
layers.on_fail: Roll back to the last known good, then find the cause with the troubleshooting work order.

layers.name: Review and learn
layers.build: Results by ad ID from both sources, judged on the deciding metric, with hand-backs.
layers.check: Does the review say which reading the sample supports, and was a learning written only at the bar?
layers.evidence: The review file.
layers.on_fail: Back to the results-review work order; an inconclusive review is a finished answer.

whole.check: Does one promise run from the ad to the page to the result that is measured, does every ad carry its ID from the ledger to its link to the snapshot, and is nothing live that a gate should have held?
whole.evidence: An ad read beside its destination page; one ID followed through the ledger, the creative file, the platform name and the link; the gates table from launch.
whole.on_fail: Go to the work order that owns the break: a promise mismatch to ad-batch or the offer, an ID gap to test-plan, an open gate to tracking-setup or the business.

recheck.when: The offer, price, proof or service area changes
recheck.note: Test-plan numbers, every claims map, the signal, and any approval that covered the old version.

recheck.when: Research adds or renames a customer type
recheck.note: Only the rows that address that type.

recheck.when: The result signal changes or goes silent
recheck.note: Spend with a silent signal is an emergency for the daily watch.

recheck.when: A learning is written
recheck.note: It outranks any play for the next batch.

states.means: The first move is made and the work orders that follow are named in order.
Ads are creative-ready and the real result has been seen arriving; the gates that are the business's to clear are named.
The platform confirmed activation of what the business approved.
A review of a judged window exists and its hand-backs are with their skills.

work_orders.record: In the reply, as one line. Each work order it runs keeps its own record.

work_orders.name: New business or offer, and what still blocks going live
say: what do you still need before we can run ads
is the business ready to run ads
can we start running ads yet
what is missing before ads can run

load_when.when: recording a new offer, or the readiness check finds gaps
writing or extending an offer file
the question is about going live or a spend amount is mentioned

required: a sentence about what is sold and a goal
helps: the business's own files, read by meaning

layers.name: Find the offer
layers.build: The one offer this request is about, with its slug.
layers.check: Is this one thing sold, with one destination and one place its result is recorded, and did you say which offer you took and why?
layers.evidence: The request and the business files read, by name.
layers.on_fail: Split into one offer file per thing sold. Ask only when the choice changes the work.

layers.name: Work out the result loop
layers.build: Funnel type, result source, the result that counts and the deciding metric.
layers.check: Does the funnel type match how the business actually gets paid, and is the result source either a real system the business named or recorded as the first live gap?
layers.evidence: The business's own words or file for how a sale completes; the system it named, or the gap line with who clears it.
layers.on_fail: A guessed result source is removed and the gap recorded as the first live gap, with the lightest options offered as Proposed. Do not pick one for them.

layers.name: Record what was supplied
layers.build: The offer file filled from what the business supplied, and nothing else.
layers.check: Does every fact carry a status and a source, with nothing taken from general knowledge of the industry and no compliance string copied?
layers.evidence: Each line's status and source, read back against where it came from.
layers.on_fail: An unsourced fact goes back to unknown. A statement that contradicts a recorded fact is recorded beside it with both dates and asked about, never silently replaced.

layers.name: Split the gaps
layers.build: Three short lists: what blocks going live, what blocks confident scaling, what only improves the work.
layers.check: Is every item on the live list a real live gate with who clears it, and is nothing on it already recorded in a file?
layers.evidence: The offer schema's live and scale markers; the files re-read for facts already on record.
layers.on_fail: Move the item to its right list; remove anything already recorded.

layers.name: Make the first move
layers.build: A next step the person can act on today, in the same reply as the gaps.
layers.check: Can they act on it today without filling in a questionnaire, and does it carry no claim, number or quote the business did not supply?
layers.evidence: The reply read as the operator: the step, and the questions asked, which are the live gaps only.
layers.on_fail: Cut the questions down to the live gaps; replace an invented detail with a marked blank.

whole.check: Could the next skill start from these files without re-asking anything, with nothing about the business outside ads/ or in the hub?
whole.evidence: The files written, re-read in order; the hub checkout unchanged.
whole.on_fail: Fix the layer that left the hole: an unsourced fact to facts, a wrong bucket to gaps.

recheck.when: A new statement contradicts a recorded fact
recheck.note: Record both with their dates and ask. Work that used the old fact (plan numbers, claims maps, the signal, approvals) is flagged for its owner, not rewritten from here.

recheck.when: The destination, funnel type or result source changes
recheck.note: The signal and the deciding metric may no longer hold.

recheck.when: A spend amount or approval is stated in chat
recheck.note: A wish is not authority: ask once whether to record it, and record it only on a yes from someone who can approve.

states.means: The first move was made or named; nothing needed recording.
Supplied facts are on file with status and source; the live gaps are named with who clears each.
Nothing this skill records is missing; the remaining gates belong to ad-setup, ad-creative, ad-launch and the business.

work_orders.record: In the reply, as one line. The offer file's Gaps section holds the lists themselves.

work_orders.name: Something changed: check again what rested on it
say: the price changed, update the ads
that claim is no longer true
update everything for the new price
work_orders.not_for: A new ad or a new batch. This is for a fact, a page or a brief that changed after work had already passed.
work_orders.live: not reached from here; a live ad that carries the old claim is reported first with a prepared pause list, and paused only on the go-ahead of someone who can approve

load_when.when: the changed fact belongs in an offer file
an approved or live ad is affected

required: what changed, in the business's words, and from when

layers.name: Record the change where the fact lives
layers.build: The changed fact in the ads/ file that owns it, with its status, source and date, and the old value kept with its date. A fact that lives in the business's own files outside ads/ (its README, its site copy, its compliance file) is listed as the business's to change.
layers.check: Is the new fact recorded in its ads/ file with a status, a source and the date it takes effect, with the old value kept rather than overwritten and nothing edited outside ads/?
layers.evidence: The offer file read back; the list of files outside ads/ that still state the old fact.
layers.on_fail: A change the business has not confirmed is recorded as Proposed and asked about once. Nothing downstream is rewritten on a guess. An edit made outside ads/ is undone and listed for the business.

layers.name: List what rested on the old version
layers.build: Every file, field, asset, number and approval in ads/ that used the old fact, each with the work order that owns it. The list goes in the reply, one line per hit: the file or ad ID, its owner work order, the layers to check again, and what was done.
layers.check: Was ads/ searched for the old value and its wording, and does each hit name its owner and the layers its work order says to check again?
layers.evidence: The search of ads/ for the old value; each hit against its work order's change table.
layers.on_fail: Search again with the other ways the fact was written (a price in words, a rounded number, a paraphrase).

layers.name: Check each dependent again
layers.optional: only the ones on the list, and only the layers their change tables name
layers.build: Each dependent corrected by its owner under its own work order. A changed ad gets a revision suffix or a new ID from ad-strategy, never an edited one. Layers the change did not touch are carried.
layers.check: Has every dependent on the list been checked again through the layers its change table names, with untouched layers carried and nothing else redone?
layers.evidence: The list of dependents with a verdict beside each; each dependent's layer record, dated after the change.
layers.on_fail: If any dependent could not be checked here, this layer is not checked: name each one and who can check it. The state is then partly rechecked.

layers.name: Set the states the new records support
layers.build: Ledger statuses and approvals brought in line: a changed ad drops to the state its new record supports, and an approval that covered the old version is named as no longer covering it.
layers.check: Is every changed ad at the state its new record supports, and is every approval that covered an old version named as needing a fresh one?
layers.evidence: The ledger beside the updated records; the approvals log.
layers.on_fail: Each status is moved by the skill that owns that transition. A live ad that carries a claim the business says is no longer true goes at the top of the reply with a prepared pause list; pausing it needs the go-ahead of someone who can approve.

whole.check: Is there nothing left in ads/ that states the old fact as current, and was nothing regenerated that the change did not touch?
whole.evidence: A second search of ads/ for the old value; the list of files changed.
whole.on_fail: Return to the dependents layer for what the search still finds.

states.means: The change is recorded and everything that rested on it is listed with its owner. The rechecks themselves are still to do.
At least one dependent was corrected and its own record is dated after the change; the rest are listed as not checked with who can check them. With none corrected, the state is recheck list prepared.
Every dependent was checked again and carries the state its new record supports.

work_orders.record: In the reply, as one line, followed by the list of dependents: one line per hit with the file or ad ID, its owner work order, the layers checked again and the verdict. Each dependent keeps its own updated record.

work_orders.name: Who buys, in their own words
say: who are our customers and what do they say
what do buyers say in their own words
work_orders.live: read-only, own ad comments only, and only when ads/authority.md exists

required: the offer, or the thing sold in a sentence
helps: the business's own emails, call notes and review exports

layers.name: Set the question
layers.build: One line: who buys this offer, what set them looking, what they feared and what words they use.
layers.check: Does the question name this offer and can sources answer it?
layers.evidence: The offer file or the request, and the line itself.
layers.on_fail: Narrow it to one offer. A question about the offer itself goes to start-here.

layers.name: Walk the sources
layers.build: Verbatim lines in research/voc.md, one row each, with source, date, link or file, ID and tag; and the table of sources walked and not reached.
layers.check: Was every recorded line read on its own page or file, never a search snippet, quoted exactly with its source, and is every source that could not be reached named?
layers.evidence: A sample of voc.md rows opened against their pages; the sources-walked table including the blocked ones.
layers.on_fail: A line that cannot be traced is removed. A blocked source is a named gap, never filled from memory.

layers.name: Build the customer types
layers.build: Customer types grouped by situation and trigger, ranked, each claim citing line IDs.
layers.check: Is each type a person in a moment, ranked by the lines and sources it can show, with a one-line type marked a lead?
layers.evidence: Each type's cited line IDs opened in voc.md; the counts of lines and sources.
layers.on_fail: An unsupported type drops to a lead or an assumption. Lines too thin to group return to the source walk.

layers.name: Keep findings apart from assumptions
layers.build: Findings, leads and assumptions in their own places, and one true data label per file.
layers.check: Does model knowledge appear only under Assumptions to test, and is the data label true?
layers.evidence: The Assumptions section and the label, read against the sources-walked table.
layers.on_fail: Move the belief under Assumptions as Proposed; correct the label.

whole.check: Could a strategist pick angles and a copywriter write in these words without having been there, with no private person identifiable?
whole.evidence: Both files read as the next skill would read them.
whole.on_fail: Fix the layer the gap came from: a missing citation to customer-types, an untraceable quote to source-walk.

recheck.when: A later run adds lines or sources
recheck.note: Earlier lines and IDs are never renumbered; a type name already on a ledger tag is not renamed.

recheck.when: The offer changes who it is for
recheck.note: Old lines stay on file with their dates.

states.means: At least one type is a finding: several lines from more than one source read this run.
Sources were thin; every type is a lead to confirm.
Nothing could be read; everything is an assumption to test. Verify before spending.

work_orders.name: What competitors run, and what can be learned
say: what ads does the competition run
work_orders.live: read-only library search through the business's own connector, where one exists

load_when.when: the library is Meta's

required: the offer, or the thing sold
helps: research/audience.md for the alternatives buyers named

layers.name: Set the question
layers.build: One line: what we are trying to learn, for this offer and these customer types.
layers.check: Does the question say what will be learned, and are the advertisers chosen in the stated order rather than by fame?
layers.evidence: The question and the who-and-why table.
layers.on_fail: Restate it; drop the giants whose brand makes their ads misleading models.

layers.name: Pull each advertiser's active ads
layers.build: Per advertiser: active ad count, oldest start date, starts in the last ninety days, format mix, versions, landing pages.
layers.check: Is every measure Observed with a library link and the date seen, with an empty result retried once and counts marked as lower bounds where only search worked?
layers.evidence: The library pages opened, or the plain statement that the library could not be opened and what was read instead.
layers.on_fail: Record what was actually seen and label the data line to match. Nothing from the library is written as Observed when it was not opened.

layers.name: Read the ads worth keeping
layers.build: A breakdown of each kept ad: hook as text, first frame and sound; style; message and proof; offer and ask; call-out; format.
layers.check: Is each kept ad broken down from what was actually seen, with every unwatched video marked not seen and nothing described from a thumbnail?
layers.evidence: Each kept ad's page or screenshot, and its watched or not-seen field.
layers.on_fail: An incomplete breakdown stays marked incomplete and cannot feed a pattern as fact.

layers.name: Click through
layers.build: Each kept ad's landing page read: headline, proof shown, offer, the one ask, friction, and where page and ad disagree.
layers.check: Was each kept ad's landing page opened and read, with any that could not be opened recorded as not reached?
layers.evidence: The pages opened, by URL and date.
layers.on_fail: Mark the page not reached; the ad's offer and ask stay as seen in the ad only.

layers.name: Keep observed apart from inferred
layers.build: Every line labelled Observed with link and date, or Inferred.
layers.check: Is every line either Observed with link and date or labelled Inferred, with no spend, result or word like winning written about any competitor's ad?
layers.evidence: The file searched for unlabelled claims and for profitable, winning, working and best-performing.
layers.on_fail: Relabel or remove the line.

layers.name: Patterns and gaps
layers.build: What everyone says, what nobody says, and each pattern written as a candidate for ad-strategy with how it would be adapted.
layers.check: Does each pattern name the advertisers it was seen at and how it would be adapted, resting only on complete observations?
layers.evidence: Each pattern traced to its swipe entries and observed rows.
layers.on_fail: A pattern resting on an unseen video or an unopened page is cut or marked a lead.

layers.name: The swipe file
layers.build: One entry per kept ad, with its link, the date seen, a screenshot when one could be taken, and why it was kept.
layers.check: Does each entry carry its link, date and what it teaches, with competitor words quoted only inside the entry?
layers.evidence: The swipe folder read entry by entry.
layers.on_fail: Complete or drop the entry.

whole.check: Could ad-strategy weigh these patterns knowing exactly what was seen and what was not, with no competitor copy handed over as the business's own?
